en.unitButton_straightShooter: Shoots left or right. Input coordinates again to change direction.
en.unitButton_verticalShooter: Shoots a laser up and down.
en.unitButton_trackingBeam: Fires a laser at the nearest enemy, and deals high damage.
en.unitButton_bomb: Destroys <color=#E1341E>all units</color> in its range. Input coordinates again to detonate.
en.dialogue_intro: Commander, this is Mother Base. Sorry to wake you up early, but we are under attack! Set up our defenses!
en.system_intro1: <color=#0CCF5A>In this game, you'll create units to defend your base. Start by selecting this unit with the left mouse button.</color>
en.system_intro2: <color=#0CCF5A>Next, put the unit on a space. To do that, we will create an <color=#06DDEF>ordered pair</color>. First, select the value on the X axis with the left mouse button or by pressing the number on the keyboard.</color>
en.system_intro3: <color=#0CCF5A>Now select the value on the Y axis the same way.</color>
en.buildQueueFull: Can only build 3 units at a time!
en.spaceOccupied: A unit is already on this space!
